title: What If You Drank Your Own Recycled Pee Every Day?

scenes.text: What if every glass of water you drank was recycled from pee and sweat? Astronauts do that.
On the International Space Station, crew members use about one gallon of water a day.
Urine is distilled, and breath and sweat are captured from the cabin air by dehumidifiers.
A brine processor added in 2021 squeezes out the last drops of water from the leftover brine.
NASA says the system now recovers 98 percent of the water the crew brings aboard, up from about 93.
The water is filtered, tested by sensors, and treated with iodine. Missions to Mars will depend on it.
